title: Concierge handoff — onsite vendor quickmap
content:
Quick reference for concierge / on-site handoffs and rapid vendor liaising. Save this to your phone and the event pocket folder. Use as the single source for last-minute swaps and reimbursement notes.

Topline goal:
- Smooth handoff between traveling rep and local concierge/vendor with minimal context switching and clean receipts for finance.

Before departure (24–48h)
- Confirm arrival ETA + room block name with concierge (hotel name, confirmation #). Copy confirmation into Slack thread.
- Cross-check vendor list (see bottom) against PO/contract numbers and confirm arrival windows.
- Prepare cash float amount (if required) and note exact per-diem allowances by attendee (see per-diem section).

Essentials to hand off physically:
- Vendor contact card (printout) with: name, company, mobile, backup mobile, on-site lead name, expected arrival window, PO/contract number (short).
- Finance envelope: credit card copy (last 4 digits), cash float (labelled), petty-expense slip template (attached to receipts).
- Tech keys: Wi‑Fi SSID/password, meeting-room AV passcodes, keycard drop location.

Suggested Slack/check-in script to paste when you hand off:
"Hi @concierge-team — handing off arrival duties for Redwood booth 5 to @NAME. Arrival ETA 14:30. Primary vendor: PixelSet Events (Asha) + backup: Rapid AV (Tony). PO EVM-4321. Please confirm setup time and that the AV cable bag is staged in storage B. Mark receipts with 'BOOTH5-2026-03' and upload to the event receipts folder by end of day. Ping me on my mobile if any changes."

Receipt & expense rules (finance-friendly)
- Always capture vendor name, date, itemized line, tax amount, and method of payment. If cash, note the recipient and reason on the receipt.
- Tag receipts with shorthand code: EVENT-<city>-<yyyyMM>-<booth#> (example: EVENT-NYC-202603-B5).
- For tips/gratuities: do not combine with other expenses on same line; list separately and annotate "gratuity".
- Submit photos of receipts within 48 hours. For missing paper receipts, vendor confirmation email + bank transaction is acceptable (attach both).

Per-diem & petty cash cheat-sheet
- Standard (US events): $70/day for meals. If venue provides lunch, reduce personal meal per-diem by $18.
- Local taxis under $25: use petty cash and label with passenger initials + route. Over $25: prefer card and capture receipt.
- Lodging incidental charges (mini-bar, pay TV): personal; do not submit unless pre-approved.

On-site troubleshooting quick rules
- AV no show: contact backup AV (Rapid AV) immediately; escalate to Event Lead if backup ETA > 30m.
- Bad internet: switch to vendor hotspot (PixelSet 4G-Hotspot) — password on vendor card. If vendor hotspot not available, request hotel engineering prioritize meeting-room VLAN (ask concierge for priority ticket).
- Missing crate/kit: check storage B (loading dock) and then staging area C. If still missing, open ticket with logistics and request local courier; keep the proof of courier charge for expense.

Vendor contacts (alpha by service)
- PixelSet Events — contact: Asha Rao — mobile: +1 (646) 555-0198 — backup: +1 (917) 555-2021 — services: booth build, furniture, basic install — PO reference: EVM-4321 — notes: bring two AV tie-down straps; label crates with "RDW-B5".
- Rapid AV — contact: Tony Morales — mobile: +1 (347) 555-3344 — services: AV, projector, mics — contract hours: 07:00–20:00 — backup for PixelSet AV.
- CityCourier — contact: Lina Gomez — mobile: +1 (646) 555-6600 — services: same-day deliveries, crate pick-up/drop-off — billing: COD or use CC on file (card last4: 3324).
- Concierge Hub (Hotel) — contact: Front Desk/Events — direct line: +1 (212) 555-1212 — engineering ext: 402 — Wi‑Fi: RDW_EVENT_Guest / pass: rdw2026!
- On-site Transport (shuttle/taxi partner) — contact: Felix Cars — mobile: +1 (646) 555-7788 — code: REDWOOD20 (10% fleet discount) — invoice to: events@redwood.ai

Documenting handoff (minimum)
- Timestamp the Slack handoff (copy/paste the script).
- Take a quick photo of the vendor contact card and final crate label. Upload both to the event folder.
- Confirm the incoming person's name, phone, and that they have physical copies of the vendor card + finance envelope.

Post-event cleanup for receipts (48–72h)
- Ensure all receipts are in the event receipts folder and named: YYYYMMDD_VENDOR_SHORT.pdf (example: 20260310_PIXELSET.pdf).
- Reconcile petty cash: list of disbursements + leftover cash total, signed by both handoff parties.
- Submit consolidated expense report using the finance template (link in linked_artifacts) and note any nonstandard approvals.

Common gotchas + fixes
- Vendor charges wrong company name on invoice: ask vendor for corrected invoice referencing PO and remit-to details. If they refuse, add a short email thread approving the charge with CFO copy for audit trail.
- Tips mixed on card slip: ask vendor for a detailed receipt or write a small note with initials on the receipt and attach an email confirmation.

Notes to self (quick):
- Keep two printed vendor cards in your passport/boarding folder.
- Always ask for day-of event manager mobile, not just office line.
- Bring a spare power strip + C13 cable in carry-on (common missing item).

If anything is unclear during handoff, call me: Priya Ranganathan — mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123 (voice preferred).

Revision history:
- 2026-02-28: initial draft (Priya)
- 2026-03-05: added Rapid AV backup + petty-cash rules (Daniel)
- 2026-03-12: updated hotel Wi‑Fi credentials and courier billing note (Mina)

End of quickmap. Keep this copy as the event pocket reference; any operational changes should be pushed to the Confluence playbook after the event.
